channel.title: U4Claude
channel.description: Updates to U4Claude (Arcanii Mod) — Claude.ai usage menu bar app for macOS.

item.title: v1.9.3
item.description:
v1.9.3 — Missing limits, stale data, settings tabs

Four upstream fixes. No re-login required.

  • A missing 5-hour limit no longer wipes out the whole reading. If Claude returned that one window empty — as some Team plans do — the entire response was discarded, along with the 7-day and per-model numbers in it.
  • Plans without a usage dashboard now say so. Free accounts and Team/Enterprise orgs without the member dashboard used to be told to check their credentials, which were never the problem.
  • A failed refresh keeps the numbers you were looking at, behind a small "Showing cached data" banner, instead of replacing them with an error page. Errors you need to act on still take over.
  • The settings tab strip no longer gets clipped off the top of the window.

See the full release notes.

item.title: v1.9.2
item.description:
v1.9.2 — Rate-limit backoff

One fix. No re-login required.

  • "Too many requests" now clears itself. Hitting a rate limit didn't change how often the app polled, so it kept asking every 60 seconds and renewed the limit instead of letting it lapse. The app now pauses and resumes on its own, honoring the server's requested wait when it sends one.
  • Opening the popover no longer makes it worse. Doing so used to switch smart mode to its fastest tier — so looking at the error re-armed the problem. That escalation is now skipped while a rate limit is in effect.

See the full release notes.

item.title: v1.9.1
item.description:
v1.9.1 — Widget labels and per-account notifications

A bug-fix release. No re-login required.

  • Widget tiles show the real weekly model name. v1.9.0 fixed the popover label but the widget still had fixed "Opus"/"Sonnet" tiles, so the same number appeared under two different names.
  • Switching accounts no longer fires a false "limit reset" notification. Usage was compared against the previous fetch even when it belonged to a different account.
  • Switching accounts no longer swallows a warning. Notification records are now tracked per account, not just per limit type.

See the full release notes.

item.title: v1.9.0
item.description:
v1.9.0 — Weekly model limits, fixed notifications

Weekly per-model limits are read and labeled correctly again, notifications actually appear, and browser sign-in gains a fallback. No re-login required.

  • Weekly per-model limits are back, with their real names. Claude's API moved these out of the dedicated Opus/Sonnet fields, so v1.8.0 showed no weekly model row at all on affected accounts. The row returns, labeled with the actual model (e.g. "Fable"), and a third or later model now gets its own row.
  • Notifications no longer vanish when the app is in front. Usage and reset alerts were silently suppressed whenever the popover or settings window was open.
  • Sign-in recovers instead of dead-ending. Paste the callback link back if the browser redirect never arrives; retries no longer hang, and expired tokens refresh themselves.
  • Requests report your real language instead of a hardcoded zh-CN, and refresh timers no longer silently fail to start.

See the full release notes.

item.title: v1.8.0
item.description:
v1.8.0 — Sign in with Claude (browser OAuth)

The sign-in flow moves to your browser, plus a new display option and correctness/localization fixes. No re-login required to update.

  • Sign in with Claude — system-browser OAuth. "Add account" now opens your default browser for the Claude OAuth (PKCE) flow instead of an embedded WebView, so Google, Microsoft, enterprise SSO, and passkey logins all work. OAuth accounts read usage with a Bearer token and skip the Cloudflare header path. Existing session-key accounts are unchanged and keep the embedded WebLogin.
  • Custom display can be scoped to the menu bar only. New toggle: the popover then falls back to smart display and shows every limit with data.
  • Extra Usage no longer silently disappears when the API returns fractional credits.
  • Localization fixes. The HTTP-error message and the auth-error "Go to Settings" button are now correct in all five languages; an expired session key reports the right error.

See the full release notes.

item.title: v1.7.1
item.description:
v1.7.1 — Currency symbols + Chrome 149

A small maintenance release — no migration, no re-login.

  • Extra Usage shows your billing currency's symbol. Amounts were hardcoded with $ regardless of currency; they now render $, €, £, ¥, ₩, CA$, A$, R$, or ₹ for your account (raw ISO code for anything unmapped). No visible change if you bill in USD. Backport of upstream 4dc411b, plus KRW (₩) for the Korean locale.
  • Spoofed Chrome user-agent bumped 148 → 149, tracking the current Chrome stable so Cloudflare keeps seeing a current browser.

See the full release notes.

item.title: v1.7.0
item.description:
v1.7.0 — App Sandbox enabled

U4Claude now runs under macOS App Sandbox. Defense in depth, a verifiable "no telemetry" claim, and alignment with Apple's distribution direction.

Heads-up on update

  • One-click re-login expected. App Sandbox isolates Keychain items into a per-app access group. You'll see "Authentication not configured" after the update; open Auth Settings → Browser Login and sign back into claude.ai (it should remember your browser session). Re-pair per account if you have multiple.
  • Settings should carry over. cfprefsd handles UserDefaults migration transparently. We log a [SandboxBootstrap] notice on first launch to catch any case where the carry-over doesn't take.

Also in this release

  • "Reset Widgets" retired. The hard-reset tier used a subprocess (killall chronod) which the sandbox forbids; the medium tier alone wasn't worth the menu real estate. Normal WidgetCenter reloads on every successful fetch handle most refresh issues.

See the full release notes for the entitlements + Info.plist details and a verification recipe.

item.title: v1.6.4
item.description:
v1.6.4 — Three upstream backports

  • Google sign-in via the WebLogin window now works. Added a WKUIDelegate so Google's window.open()-based OAuth flow no longer silently drops, broadened allowedDomains to base domains plus youtube.com (Google bounces through accounts.youtube.com/CheckConnection), and added a willCloseNotification observer so the WebView releases when you close the window via the red dot.
  • "View Claude Usage" menu item replaced with "Claude Status", pointing at status.claude.com. More useful during outages than re-opening the usage page in a browser.
  • Detail rings now visually invert in remaining mode. Previously the row toggle only swapped subtitle text; now the ring itself drains from the top, the center label flips from "Used" to "Available", and the whole transition uses a snappier spring curve. Mode preference is also eager-loaded so there's no "Used"→"Available" flash when you open the popover.

All three backported from upstream commits 94dabbf, 5d022c5, fdeb0c1. See the full release notes.

item.title: v1.6.3
item.description:
v1.6.3 — Two upstream polish backports

  • Japanese 24h-format hour suffix now uses the correct kanji 時 (U+6642) instead of the visually-identical Simplified Chinese 时 (U+65F6). Affects reset-time displays for Japanese-locale users.
  • Session Key hint text generalized — removed the obsolete sk-ant-sid01- reference in all 5 locales (Claude's current cookies use sk-ant-sid without the 01- suffix).

Both are upstream-merged behavior fixes (commits 753b6bc, 48bccc9). See the full release notes.

item.title: v1.6.2
item.description:
v1.6.2 — In-app widget recovery

New Reset Widgets menu item in the popover's … menu. Two tiers:

  • Click — medium reset: writes a fresh App Group snapshot, invalidates WidgetKit's configuration cache, and reloads all timelines. No subprocess; fixes most rendering glitches.
  • ⌥-click — hard reset: medium + restarts chronod via killall. Last-resort recovery for the cache wedge that produced opaque-black widget tiles after the v1.6.1 install. Triggers a TCC prompt on first run.

See the full release notes.

item.title: v1.6.1
item.description:
v1.6.1 — Upstream backport pass

Three small bug fixes from upstream's v3.0.0 cycle, applied to this fork:

  • Refresh on system wake — usage updates immediately after the Mac wakes from sleep instead of waiting up to 10 minutes for the next timer fire.
  • Idle-mode timer restart — opening the popover or hitting manual refresh from a smart-mode idle tier now correctly restarts the timer at the active 1-min interval instead of running on the old longer one.
  • 5-hour and 7-day always shown in smart mode; 7-day shows for new accounts with a 0% placeholder when no data has accumulated yet.

See the full release notes.

item.title: v1.6.0
item.description:
v1.6.0 — U4Claude learns to remember

History is now visible — both in the popover and on the desktop.

  • 24-hour sparkline strip under every limit row in the popover, color-matched and live-updating.
  • Four new desktop widget kinds: Large Dashboard (all 5 limits), Sparkline (small/medium with 24h trend), Dual Sparkline (medium 5h + 7d side-by-side), and ExtraLarge (full kitchen-sink dashboard with sparkline strip).
  • Storage rebuilt on NDJSON in the App Group container — O(1) line append per fetch instead of v1.5.x's full-file rewrite. One-time migration drains the legacy file on first launch.
  • 14 new tests for the storage layer; total 35 → 49.

Add the new widgets via right-click desktop → Edit Widgets… → search "Claude Usage". See the full release notes.

item.title: v1.5.1
item.description:
v1.5.1 — Upstream v2.6.1 backports

  • HTTP/3 disabled on all Claude API requests — keeps usage traffic on HTTP/2 over TCP so it can't slip around TCP-only system proxies as opportunistic UDP/QUIC.
  • Extra Usage shows cents — $0.45/$50 instead of $0/$50. Limit stays whole-dollar; the used portion gets two decimal places.

See the full release notes.

item.title: v1.5.0
item.description:
v1.5.0 — API refactor + test coverage

No user-visible changes. Same UI, same data flow, same widget. Internal-only release.

  • Response models (UsageResponse, ExtraUsageResponse, UsageData, ExtraUsageData, etc.) extracted into a dependency-free file so the SwiftPM test target can cover them.
  • 24 new tests for toUsageData() and toExtraUsageData() — including the legacy-field fallback for Extra Usage and the fractional-second rounding for reset times. Test count 11 → 35.
  • fetchOrganizations migrated to async throws -> [Organization]; all three callsites (auth settings, welcome, web login) updated together.

See the full release notes.

item.title: v1.4.1
item.description:
v1.4.1 — Quick-wins polish

  • Ring illumination slider. New "Popover Appearance" card in General Settings — drag from 0% (off) through subtle to 100% (vivid, the v1.4.0 default) to dial the popover ring glow. Above 50% the macOS-26 Liquid Glass material is layered in; below it the slider just dims the surrounding shadows.
  • Auto-relogin recovers from a dismissed login window. The session-expired throttle now clears on explicit retry (manual refresh or popover-open fetch), so the WebLogin window re-prompts on the next failure instead of latching forever.
  • Spoofed Chrome user-agent bumped 140 → 148 to keep up with Cloudflare's heuristics.

See the full release notes.

item.title: v1.4.0
item.description:
v1.4.0 — Desktop widget

Drag the new "Claude Usage" widget onto your desktop (Edit Widgets → search for it). Two sizes:

  • Small — single ring with percentage and reset countdown.
  • Medium — both 5-hour and 7-day rings side-by-side.

The widget reads from an App Group snapshot the main app writes on every successful fetch — no extra API calls, no Cloudflare to dodge, no session-expiry handling. WidgetCenter is pinged on each fetch so the rings update immediately.

Also: switched the build script to automatic signing with -allowProvisioningUpdates so the App Group entitlements work end-to-end without pre-issued provisioning profiles.

item.title: v1.3.2
item.description:
v1.3.2 — Sparkle plumbing fix

v1.3.0 and v1.3.1 shipped without working Sparkle. The Sparkle keys were silently dropped from the auto-generated Info.plist, and the menu's "Check for updates…" handler had a flaky AppDelegate cast. This release fixes both:

  • Static Config/Info.plist with SUFeedURL, SUPublicEDKey, and SUEnableAutomaticChecks baked in.
  • AppDelegate.shared static reference replaces the unreliable NSApp.delegate as? AppDelegate cast.

v1.3.0/v1.3.1 users will need to install this manually — their Sparkle has no feed URL and can't auto-update. After v1.3.2, all future updates flow normally.

item.title: v1.3.1
item.description:
v1.3.1 — Glassy glow on the popover rings

Cosmetic release. The 5-hour and 7-day rings now render as glowing glass tubes:

  • 4-stop linear gradient on the stroke for a translucent glass-tube body.
  • Tight color-matched shadows for a lit-from-within glow without the broad fog.
  • On macOS 26+, the rings additionally pick up the system Liquid Glass material via .glassEffect(in:). Older macOS keeps the gradient-only fallback.

No data, API, or build-pipeline changes — pure UI.

item.title: v1.3.0
item.description:
v1.3.0 — Sparkle in-app updates

This is the first release where updates install with one click via Sparkle, replacing the old "download → drag-to-Applications → relaunch" flow.

  • Updates are EdDSA signature-verified before install — a tampered or corrupted DMG is rejected.
  • Background check still 24h cadence; manual check available from the right-click menu.
  • Custom UpdateChecker deleted (~290 lines); DataRefreshManager is now strictly about Claude usage data.

See the full release notes for the migration story and what's deferred.

item.title: v1.2.0
item.description:
v1.2.0 — Auth-failure UX overhaul, multi-account ergonomics, history export

  • Auto-prompt re-login when the session expires — no more "right-click → Auth Settings" detour.
  • ⌘1–⌘9 keyboard shortcuts for switching between configured accounts.
  • Rolling usage history capture + CSV export from the diagnostics view.
  • Better Cloudflare vs. session-invalid distinction in the API layer.
  • About tab simplified, log messages normalized to English, Chrome user-agent bumped to 140.

See the full release notes for the complete changelog and internal cleanup.
